intent: Take bt_audio.sh and arch_perf_report.sh off the shell-coverage allowlist. Both were already tested to their reachable ceiling; the closing-brace fix in d989cd7e removed the instrument artifact that was holding them below 100%, so they now meet the bar with no exemption.
scope: Non-goal: any test or lib change -- the tests landed in a5b6663c and ffcf99f1, the instrument fix in d989cd7e, and this commit only records the consequence
Non-goal: bt_adapter.sh, still exempt at 98.55% for the backslash-continued assignment flavour
changes: Confirmed the diff removes exactly those two lines and nothing else.

verification.evidence: bt_audio.sh: 127/127 lines = 100.00%, exit code 0. Measured at the --min 100 bar so a shortfall would be a non-zero exit rather than a number to misread.

verification.command: bash meta/scripts/check_shell_coverage.sh on bt_audio.sh, arch_perf_report.sh, bt_report.sh and bt_pairing.sh
verification.evidence: 'check_shell_coverage.sh: every checked shell library meets the coverage bar', exit 0, run with both allowlist lines already removed so neither lib had an exemption. bt_report.sh and bt_pairing.sh are included to confirm the two libs cleared earlier in the session did not regress.
Exactly two removed lines, both the intended ones, and no additions. The allowlist drops from 95 to 93 fixes/lib-relevant entries.

risks: Both libs are now gated at 100% with no exemption, so any future change to them, to their tests, or to continuation_lines() that lowers their coverage will fail the commit. That is the point of clearing them, but it means the closing-brace exclusion is now load-bearing: reverting d989cd7e without also restoring these two allowlist lines would turn every subsequent commit red.

The measurements were made in a detached worktree under the scratchpad, because the jail aborts on any working-tree delta during a run. The libs and tests were byte-identical to the commits named above.
rollback: git revert the commit; that restores both allowlist lines and returns the two libs to exempt status.
After rollback, run bash meta/scripts/check_shell_coverage.sh on both libs and confirm it exits 0 with them exempt.
